Nicholas Pooran hits fastest century, breaks records in T20 match

West Indies cricketer Nicholas Pooran achieved a record-breaking feat by scoring the fastest century in a T20 match. His explosive innings included 13 sixes and 5 fours, surpassing previous records held by Vaibhav, Abhishek, and Pant. The match also saw Kieron Pollard reach 1000 sixes, with the event described as a 'Caribbean storm' in America.
